tool_schemas.name: get_youtube_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Resolves a YouTube video by `youtube_video_id` or `video_url` and returns the transcript in the requested `language` (or our best available default), optionally including time-coded segments when `include_segments` is true; results may be served from cache unless `refresh` is set. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, if both are provided but disagree, or if the URL/ID is not a valid YouTube video reference; raises NOT_FOUND when the video cannot be resolved or no transcript is available in any language (or in the requested language when explicitly provided). Raises UNAUTHORIZED when the API key is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to use transcript retrieval, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas or throttles are exceeded.

video_url.description: Full YouTube video URL to resolve and fetch the transcript for.

youtube_video_id.description: YouTube video ID (11-char) to fetch the transcript for.

language.description: Preferred transcript language code (e.g., en, en-US); if omitted, server picks a best/default.

include_segments.description: Whether to include time-coded transcript segments in addition to plain transcript text.

refresh.description: If true, bypass/refresh cached transcript and re-fetch from upstream when possible.

tool_schemas.name: search_youtube_videos
tool_schemas.description: Searches YouTube for videos matching `query` and returns a page of enriched video results ordered by `order_by`, filtered by the optional channel/time/language/region/safe-search parameters. Results are paged with `limit`, and when more results are available the response includes a `cursor` that can be supplied on the next call to continue from where you left off. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid parameter values (including `limit` out of range, malformed timestamps, or `published_after` later than `published_before`), UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API key, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to search, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas or throttles are exceeded.

query.description: Search keyword/query to use for YouTube video search.

limit.description: Maximum number of videos to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing results.

published_after.description: Only include videos published at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

published_before.description: Only include videos published at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

channel_id.description: Filter to a specific YouTube channel ID (not the internal ULID).

language.description: Prefer/boost results for a given language code (e.g., en, es).

region_code.description: Region/country code to localize results (e.g., US, GB).

tool_schemas.name: get_channel_info
tool_schemas.description: Resolves the channel behind the provided `video_url` and returns channel metadata plus up to `recent_videos_limit` most recent videos (default 10), serving cached data unless `refresh` is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when `video_url` is not a valid YouTube video URL, NOT_FOUND when the video or its channel cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT when `refresh` is requested but upstream refresh is currently unavailable for the resolved entity. Raises UNAUTHORIZED for missing/invalid API key, FORBIDDEN when the key is not permitted to access channel metadata, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas or throttles are exceeded.

video_url.description: A YouTube video URL used to resolve the channel and fetch channel info plus recent videos.

recent_videos_limit.description: How many recent videos to return (defaults to 10 if omitted).

refresh.description: If true, bypass/refresh cached channel and video metadata and re-fetch from upstream when possible.

tool_schemas.name: list_tool_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists tool invocation audit records for the calling API key, newest-first, optionally filtered by tool name, status, and resolved YouTube identifiers. Returns a page of tool_requests plus a pagination cursor when more results are available. Refuses with FORBIDDEN if the API key is not `active`.

limit.description: Maximum number of tool_requests to return (default 50, max 200).

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

status.description: Filter by tool request lifecycle status.

tool_name.description: Filter to a specific tool name.

youtube_video_id.description: Filter by resolved YouTube video ID.

youtube_channel_id.description: Filter by resolved YouTube channel ID.

created_after.description: Only include tool_requests created at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp.

created_before.description: Only include tool_requests created at or before this ISO-8601 timestamp.

tool_schemas.name: get_tool_request
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single tool_requests record by its internal id, including captured input, status, and any stored output/error. Refuses with NOT_FOUND if the id does not exist or does not belong to the calling API key, and FORBIDDEN if the API key is not `active`.

tool_schemas.name: get_video
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a normalized video record by `youtube_video_id` (preferred) or internal `id`. Returns the stored metadata and any linked channel_id when present. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if neither identifier is provided, and NOT_FOUND if the video does not exist.

tool_schemas.name: get_channel
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a normalized channel record by `youtube_channel_id` (preferred), `handle`, or internal `id`. Returns the stored channel metadata. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR if no identifier is provided, and NOT_FOUND if the channel does not exist.

youtube_channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID to fetch (not the internal ULID).

tool_schemas.name: refresh_transcript
tool_schemas.description: Forces a retry of transcript retrieval for an existing transcript record by moving its lifecycle status to `fetching` and queuing an upstream re-fetch. Returns the updated transcript record (initially in `fetching`). Refuses with CONFLICT if the transcript is already in `fetching`, VALIDATION_ERROR if no identifier is provided, and NOT_FOUND if the transcript cannot be found.

video_id.description: Internal videos id; used with the transcript key fields to identify a transcript.

language.description: Transcript language code (e.g., en, en-US). Required when using video_id.

is_auto_generated.description: Whether the transcript is auto-generated. Required when using video_id.

source.description: Transcript source. Required when using video_id.

metadata.name: YouTube Insights
metadata.description: This backend powers a YouTube research/insights API that lets clients (via API keys) search YouTube videos, fetch channel info (plus recent videos), and retrieve/cached transcripts for videos.
